memories.text: Spirometry with reversibility: FEV1 1.65 L (55% predicted), FVC 2.30 L (70% predicted), FEV1/FVC 0.72. Post-bronchodilator FEV1 1.78 L (8% improvement). Consistent with mild obstructive airway disease, reversible component consistent with asthma.
